name: Catholic Housing and Community Services
statusReason: Website is live (chcsphiladelphia.org); operates as the senior-housing arm of Catholic Charities of the Archdiocese of Philadelphia, with current programs and recent groundbreakings; IRS recognized 2025-06-01.
notes: Senior-housing/community-services program of Catholic Charities, Archdiocese of Philadelphia (five-county region; nine senior-housing buildings). Site intermittently refused direct connection; leadership confirmed via search of chcsphiladelphia.org/leadership and Archdiocese pages.

name: HumanGood East
statusReason: Operating entity is the former Presby's Inspired Life, which affiliated with HumanGood in 2019 and now operates under the HumanGood brand; live national site, last 990 in 2023.
notes: EIN 232828862 (IRS recognized 1996-10-01) corresponds to the Philadelphia-region affiliate formerly known as Presby's Inspired Life (earlier Presbyterian Homes), which described itself as serving Philadelphia for 60+ years and affiliated with California-based HumanGood in June 2019. HumanGood itself formed in 2016 (2015 merger of ABHOW and be.group, rebranded 2017). No founding year is cleanly attributable to this specific EIN, so null. National brand CEO is not an 'East' ED; no local executive director named for this entity, so eds left empty rather than fabricated. The homepage URL in the batch (humangood.org/index.html) 404s; live site is humangood.org.
